questions.question: Which type of language is recognized by a Pushdown Automaton (PDA)?
Which data structure is used by a PDA to store additional information?
A context-free grammar (CFG) consists of which set of components?

answers.a: Terminals, non-terminals, start symbol, and production rules
answers.c: Initial state, final state, and stack symbols

questions.question: Which of the following problems can be solved by a context-free grammar (CFG) but not by a DFA?
What is the difference between a DFA and a PDA?

answers.a: A PDA uses a stack, while a DFA does not
answers.b: A DFA recognizes context-free languages, while a PDA recognizes regular languages
answers.c: A PDA can only recognize finite languages
answers.d: A DFA can use a stack, while a PDA cannot

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a context-free language?

answers.a: The set of all strings with equal numbers of a's and b's
answers.b: The set of all palindromes over {a, b}
answers.c: The set of binary strings with an even number of zeros
answers.d: The set of all strings that contain 'aa' as a substring

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT true for context-free grammars?

answers.a: They can generate some non-regular languages
answers.b: They are equivalent in power to PDAs
answers.c: They are closed under union and concatenation
